# czc-v2026.10.22.1 (0.2.17.18)

Codex CLI wire fidelity, calibrated against recordings of the real codex-cli 0.163.0 binary instead of source reading. OAuth accounts keep the multi-user relay model: one account presents as one device, each downstream conversation as one Codex thread on it.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.21.9

### Recording harness

- New `backend/tools/codexgolden` runs an installed Codex CLI against local fake endpoints (isolated `HOME`/`CODEX_HOME`, synthetic ChatGPT `auth.json`, all base URLs on `127.0.0.1`) and records TLS ClientHellos, raw header order, zstd-decoded bodies and WS frames. Hard-coded hosts (`ab.chatgpt.com`) are refused by a local proxy, keyring access is disabled, and strace fails the run on any non-loopback `connect(2)`.
- Recordings for 0.163.0 live in `backend/internal/pkg/codexwire/testdata/golden/0.163.0/`; transport and header tests diff our output against them.

### Transport

- **HTTP lane is now OpenSSL + HTTP/1.1.** The recordings show the Linux CLI sends HTTP through native-tls (OpenSSL 3.6) with no ALPN and a new connection per request; rustls + h2 is only used with a custom CA. New `openssl36` TLS profile; this corrects the claim in czc-v2026.10.21.6 that official HTTP traffic negotiates h2.
- **WS rustls ClientHello fixed:** adds the `0x00ff` SCSV, aws-lc-rs signature algorithm order including ML-DSA-44/65/87, and reuses the X25519 key from the X25519MLKEM768 share as rustls does.
- HTTP `/responses` header order recalibrated from the recording (`version` first, `user-agent` last, then `host`, `content-length`). Bodyless requests carry no `content-length`, like hyper.
- Proxy CONNECT no longer sends `User-Agent: Go-http-client/1.1`; the WS lane adds `Proxy-Connection: Keep-Alive` like the CLI's tungstenite fork; `https://` proxies now get a TLS handshake before CONNECT (previously CONNECT and `Proxy-Authorization` went out in plaintext).

### Background calls

- Token refresh / exchange, `wham/*` (usage, reset credits), accounts/check, subscriptions, settings and the OAuth models manifest now use the same OpenSSL h1 client and the recorded header orders. Firefox impersonation and the `Codex Desktop` / `zh-CN` / `sec-fetch-*` headers are removed. Models requests no longer send `If-None-Match`.
- Usage refresh for OAuth accounts reads `GET /backend-api/wham/usage` instead of sending a throwaway `"hi"` `/responses` turn.
- Token refresh runs the accounts/check / subscriptions / training calls at most once a day per ChatGPT account (onboarding keeps them).
- Tibo route probes are off by default.

### Identity

- Full fingerprint mode no longer merges every user of an account into one session: installation id stays per account; `session_id` = `thread_id` is a UUIDv7 per downstream conversation; `turn_id` / `turn_started_at_unix_ms` stay fixed across a tool loop and change on a new user message.
- `session-id`, `thread-id`, `x-client-request-id` are always UUIDs on HTTP, WS and in `client_metadata` (16-hex isolation keys map to a stable v7 through one function, so all lanes agree).
- Chat-completions and the messages bridge no longer send an underscored `session_id`; the messages bridge no longer sends `OpenAI-Beta`.
- The turn-metadata `sandbox` tag follows the outbound User-Agent platform (`seccomp` for the Linux UA).

### Request body

- Codex ≥ 0.162 requests (base prompt in `input[0]` tagged `model.base_instructions`) no longer get a synthetic ~21 KB top-level `instructions`, which made the upstream receive the base prompt twice.

### WebSocket

- No client-initiated pings (30 s idle sweep, ingress preflight); the CLI only answers server pings.
- No pre-dialed spare sockets.
- `previous_response_id` is only sent on the socket that produced it; otherwise the full input is sent, like the CLI after a reconnect.

### Memory

- permessage-deflate context-takeover windows no longer keep the largest message alive on idle sockets (a 4 MiB request pinned ~4 MiB per connection); flate writers are pooled.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.18`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in, no database migration. Default config changes (an explicit value in `config.yaml` still wins):

| Key | Old default | New default |
|---|---|---|
| `gateway.openai_ws.codex_http_h2_enabled` | `true` | `false` (OpenSSL h1 lane) |
| `gateway.openai_ws.min_idle_per_account` | `4` | `0` |
| `gateway.openai_ws.client_ping_enabled` | — | `false` (new) |
| `gateway.openai_tibo_route.enabled` | — | `false` (new) |

If `config.yaml` sets `min_idle_per_account` it must stay `<= max_idle_per_account`. To keep Tibo routing, set `gateway.openai_tibo_route.enabled: true`.

## Compatibility

- Outbound session ids for OAuth Codex accounts change shape (per-conversation UUIDv7 instead of one account-wide id). Upstream prompt-cache affinity restarts once per conversation after the upgrade.
- Non-Codex clients (chat-completions, Anthropic messages, generic Responses) still get the gateway's top-level `instructions` and prompt template; only Codex ≥ 0.162 traffic changed.

## Verification

Passed:

- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `go vet -tags unit ./...`
- `go test -count=1 ./...` — 52/52 packages
- New golden tests: ClientHello for the OpenSSL HTTP, rustls WS and rustls custom-CA lanes; HTTP `/responses` and WS handshake header order; token refresh, accounts/check and models header order; captured 0.163.0 body through `Forward()`; proxy CONNECT bytes
- Handshake tests against local servers preferring X25519MLKEM768, X25519 only, and P-256 only (HelloRetryRequest)

Failed or skipped:

- `go test -tags unit ./...`: 12 tests in `internal/service` fail (Anthropic chat/messages usage, Responses Lite tool normalization, GPT-6.1-sol long-context pricing, 401 temp-unsched scope). They fail identically on `dev-czc` before this change.
- `TestH2PoolEndToEndTLS` flakes (2 of 300 runs: "stream closed before response headers") on both this release and `dev-czc`; the h2 lane is now off by default.
- golangci-lint is not installed locally; not run.
- Frontend unchanged; rebuilt for the embed build only.
- No live traffic test: the OpenSSL h1 lane, `/wham/usage` refresh and the removed `OpenAI-Beta` on the messages bridge were not exercised against chatgpt.com before deploy. Watch for Cloudflare 403s and 404s on `/backend-api/codex/responses`.

## Rollback

Restore the backup `/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.22.1-<UTC timestamp>` (previous release czc-v2026.10.21.9) and restart `sub2api.service`. Without rolling back the binary, `SUB2API_CODEX_DEVICE_CLIENT_DISABLED=1` restores the old clients for background calls, and `gateway.openai_ws.codex_http_h2_enabled: true` restores the rustls-h2 HTTP lane.
